name: web-pastel-gradient-service-cards-with-numbered-mono-labels
title: 'Services.' heading with tall rounded cards in lilac, mint and blush gradients, each with a (00N) label, an icon, caps title and short text
whatItIs: A white page with a giant bold 'Services.' and a horizontal row of tall rounded cards with soft gradients (lilac, mint, blush), each with a monospace number in brackets '( 001 )', a thin black icon (palette, code, magnifier), an uppercase title (Branding, Development, SEO Optimization) and a short grey description at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Fresh and orderly; soft colour gradients differentiate services without heavy graphics.
techniques: Give each card its own pastel gradient.
Use one thin icon per card.
Bleed the last card off the edge.

vocabulary.definition: A card filled with a soft colour gradient.
A row whose last item is cut by the edge.
